Game Overview

At its heart, Air Block is a platformer game about leap into the whimsical world of Air Block where squirrel-bears use magic blocks to navigate obstacles. Strategize block placements, dodge threats, and collect food in a frenetic, fast-paced challenge. Master the simple controls in single-player or local multiplayer modes for endless party fun and squirrel-bear excitement.
